## Summary

Describe the user-visible change and why it belongs in `bad-map`.

## Verification

- [ ] `npm run verify`
- [ ] `npm run test:e2e:functional`
- [ ] Tests and documentation cover the change
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` records public API or behavior changes
- [ ] No generated `dist` or local test artifacts are committed

## Visual changes

Attach before/after images or state that the change has no visual effect.
